title: The long reference edits open in Photonz Dev from a try step you can follow
goal: Every speed audit this week tells you to try the 6, 20 or 60 minute reference edit by running a script, and that script opens it in the loop's test copy of the app, not the Photonz Dev you review in. So the focus feature cannot be tried from its own audit. The edits are already on this Mac; a try step should open them in Photonz Dev by a menu or a file you can click.
notes: Seen by the digests of 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17. Scripts/perf/reference-edit.sh opens with Scripts/probe-app.sh. The files: ~/Library/Caches/Photonz Reference Edit/Reference Edit 6 min.photonz (also 20, 60). The Dev app must never be rebuilt by a runner (CLAUDE.md, Three bundles); opening a file in it is fine.
acceptance: A person can open each reference edit in Photonz Dev with no terminal: either File > Open on a path the audit names, or a script option that opens it in Photonz Dev without rebuilding or quitting the Dev app
The try steps of the open long-edit and timeline tasks' latest audits (2026-11-17 pass 13 and 14, 2026-11-16 timeline and opening audits) say how to open the edit in Photonz Dev, in one step each
The audit guidance in queue/bin/runner-prompt.md says a try step names a menu, key, gesture or file, never a script to run, and how to reach the reference edits

Before building: a step that says Run Scripts/perf/reference-edit.sh opens the probe, and the files sit in ~/Library/Caches (hidden from Finder); double-clicking a .photonz picks whichever Photonz LaunchServices likes, so a file to click is not reliable. Six reports named a Help > Reference Edit menu that does not exist (grep of Sources finds none).

Chose a dashboard button on the try step (referenceEdit: 6|20|60) that runs reference-edit.sh --dev over File > Open alone, because it is one click with no terminal; File > Open (Cmd-Shift-G) stays in each setup as the fallback. Chose a person's own copy under <folder>/Photonz Dev over opening the walks' copy, because every speed walk rewrites the walks' copy fresh and would pull it out from under an open Dev window and throw away anything saved.

Verified: copy rules drilled in a temp folder (first copy, refresh when untouched and the edit changed, kept when saved into, --fresh, missing app exits 1). 6, 20 and 60 opened from the copies in the probe via open -a (list_documents: 360/1200/3600 s video documents, recordings resolved). Real pointer click on the button in Chrome against a test dashboard on :8799 pointed at the probe: 'Opened in Photonz Dev', 60 min edit open. open -a needed an absolute app path (fixed). Live dashboard restarted for the route; bad minutes refused. Dev app never touched.

Rewrote the try steps and setup of 32 long-edit reports (2026-11-12 to 11-19, incl. pass13/14, the 11-16 timeline and opening reports) to open the edit with the button; steps opening a second length got their own button. Runner prompt has the rule; video.md documents --dev. Scripts/test.sh green (exit 0). Commit 4751d023e, pushed.
